scope: Direct HTTP stalled response reads: pause/cancel, checkpoint resume, deletion and UI batch start; not full-product certification
root_cause: TcpStream response reads blocked up to 60 seconds without checking pause/cancel; resume waits for the previous worker to exit (30-second deadline).
fix: Poll task control during TCP response headers/body/chunked reads with 200ms socket waits, retaining the 60-second idle-read budget; preserve Pause/Cancel errors and range checkpoints.

fixture_corrections: The isolated unit executable first failed to load VCRUNTIME140.dll (0xc0000135); copied the existing bundled runtime next to it, then all 56 tests passed.
The multi-connection acceptance initially required active_workers == 1; inspected core_runtime.rs and corrected the assertion to > 0 because the field counts connections. Final acceptance passed.
limits: This change and stalled-network acceptance cover direct HTTP TCP response reads. HTTPS/proxy WinHTTP stalled-read cancellation, connection establishment and request-body transmission are not covered by this fix.
Java Access Bridge reported a dynamic-tree IndexOutOfBoundsException; the final UI scenario completed successfully.
The 200ms wait is a cancellation polling interval; it does not change the existing 60-second idle-read timeout. The smoke test covers an 800ms silent gap.
